title: Second-filtration row cohomology with its totalization sign
statement: Let $F:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ be additive and left exact between Grothendieck abelian categories [def-sp-left-exact-additive, def-sp-grothendieck-abelian]. Let $I$ be a bicomplex with complex index $s\in\mathbf Z$ and resolution index $r\in\mathbf N$, zero for $s<b$ for some integer $b$. Let $J$ be its $F$-mapped, extended and flipped bicomplex [def-sp-cartan-eilenberg-presentation]. Given a decreasing subcomplex filtration $L$ of its total [def-sp-filtration] with degreewise steps equal to the second-filtration sums [def-sp-double-complex-total], there exist a page-zero cohomological spectral sequence $E$ [def-sp-spectral-sequence], page-zero isomorphisms $E_0^{p,q}\cong(\operatorname{gr}^pL)^{p+q}$, and row isomorphisms $e_{r,s}:E_1^{s,r}\cong H^r(F(I^{s,\bullet}))$. The page-zero differential is the graded differential. For every $t\ge1$, $E_t^{p,q}$ is isomorphic to the cokernel of $B_t\subseteq Z_t$ [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients]. The row isomorphisms satisfy $d_1 e_{r,s+1}=(-1)^r e_{r,s}H^r(F(d_I^{s,s+1}))$, and $E_1^{p,q}=0$ for $q<0$.

proof.text: Build the spectral sequence of the filtration by the differential-object self-map construction, retaining the page-zero and cycle/boundary identifications. The graded complex at s is the row F(I.X s), extended by zero and placed in degrees s+r: the component raising s disappears on taking the quotient. Thus page one is its cohomology. To compute d₁, lift a row cocycle to L^s/L^(s+2). Its total differential has only the component raising complex degree, with coefficient (-1)^r. The connecting map is consequently (-1)^r times the map of row cohomology induced by I.d s (s+1). The extended row is zero in negative resolution degrees, so its cohomology there vanishes. This proves the negative-degree page-one clause.

theorem secondFiltration_row_cohomology
    {A : Type uA} [Category.{vA} A] [Abelian A] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{vA} A]
    {B : Type uB} [Category.{vB} B] [Abelian B] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{vB} B]
    (F : A ⥤ B) [F.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits F]
    (I : HomologicalComplex₂ A (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
    (hbelow : ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ s : ℤ, s < b → IsZero (I.X s))
    (L : DecreasingFiltration
      ((((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor F).obj I).flip).total
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))
    (hL : ∀ p n : ℤ, L.complexStep p n =
      ((((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor F).obj I).flip).secondFiltration n).step
        p) :
    ∃ (E : CohomologicalSpectralSequence B 0)
      (e₀ : ∀ p q : ℤ, (E.page 0).X (p, q) ≅ (L.gradedPiece p).X (p + q))
      (e₁ : ∀ (r : ℕ) (s : ℤ), (E.page 1).X (s, (r : ℤ)) ≅
        ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj (I.X s)).homology r),
      (∀ p q : ℤ, (E.page 0).d (p, q) (p, q + 1) ≫ (e₀ p (q + 1)).hom =
        (e₀ p q).hom ≫ (L.gradedPiece p).d (p + q) (p + (q + 1))) ∧
      (∀ (p q t : ℤ) (ht : 1 ≤ t),
        ∃ hBZ : L.complexBoundaries p (p + q) t ≤ L.complexCycles p (p + q) t,
          Nonempty ((E.page t (le_trans (by decide : (0 : ℤ) ≤ 1) ht)).X (p, q) ≅
            cokernel (Subobject.ofLE _ _ hBZ))) ∧
      (∀ (r : ℕ) (s : ℤ),
        (E.page 1).d (s, (r : ℤ)) (s + 1, (r : ℤ)) ≫ (e₁ r (s + 1)).hom =
          (r : ℤ).negOnePow • ((e₁ r s).hom ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
            ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).map (I.d s (s + 1))) r)) ∧
      (∀ p q : ℤ, q < 0 → IsZero ((E.page 1).X (p, q)))
